document.summary: An approved synthetic design authorizes portability proof without depending on mutable product documentation.
document.reviewFocus: Confirm the renderer boundary and the separation between review recording and canonical approval.

sections.title: The approved promise is consistent, portable review

blocks.decision: Which boundary owns report markup, CSS, and runtime?
blocks.recommendation: Use one skill-relative renderer and report template.
blocks.goal: Regenerate byte-identical, self-contained HTML from the same structured source, including from a copied skill in an unrelated working directory.
blocks.shape: PRD and design skills own meaning; System Diagram supplies retained JSON and generated SVG; HTML Report Designer validates both and renders the report.
blocks.why: A single rendering boundary prevents shell drift and remains portable after copying the skill.
blocks.approve: The existing single-renderer decision and its portability proof, as accepted by the synthetic Eval Product Owner.
blocks.notBuilding: Alternate report templates, alternate diagram renderers, product behavior, or automatic approval from browser state.
blocks.risks: New component shapes require shared renderer changes; missing renderer or diagram provenance blocks generation instead of falling back.
blocks.readiness: This approved synthetic design authorizes the focused portability proof, not mutable product documentation.

items: Promise
All durable reports use one visual and interaction system.
Proof
The same structured source regenerates byte-identical HTML.
Constraint
PRD and design truth remains owned by their domain skills.

API and contracts · Unchanged

sections.title: Stricter structure buys determinism and review safety

items: Cost
New component shapes require a shared renderer change.
Failure posture
Missing renderer or System Diagram provenance blocks generation rather than falling back.
Proof
Clean-copy, negative profile, deterministic regeneration, decision runtime, and browser checks pass.

blocks.title: Migration risk
blocks.text: Legacy generated reports remain readable but are not accepted as new canonical output.

sections.title: The renderer does not decide product or architecture truth

items: No automatic approval from completeness or browser state.
No alternate diagram renderer or hand-authored SVG.
No task creation or implementation behavior inside design generation.
